reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: STT Train Fleet Renewal - TGM Line

description.narrative: In December 2019, the EBRD signed a sovereign-guaranteed loan of EUR 45 million with Societe des Transports de Tunis ("TRANSTU") to finance the acquisition of new suburban rail trains for the historic TunisiGouletteiMarsa (TGM) line, which connects the centre of Tunis with the northern suburb of La Marsa. The financing also covers essential equipment for the testing and maintenance of the new trains. This loan was complemented by an equivalent loan from the EIB, signed in December 2021 and EUR 17.8 million contribution from the Government of Tunisia. The project is expected to reverse the operational decline of TRANSTU's electrified suburban line, as well as improve its financial sustainability and its relationship with the Government of Tunisia by focusing on the development of a Financial and Operational Performance Improvement Programme (FOPIP) and Corporate Development Programme (CDP). These will entail a review of the Contractual Programme and proposing concrete steps to improve the efficiency and revenue generating potential of urban transport in Tunis. The Project forms an integral part of the Tunisian national transport sector development strategy and is a priority investment under the country's Strategic Plan "Tunisia 2016-20".
